title: Aaron Rodgers can become the fifth quarterback in NFL history with 70,000 passing yards

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Rodgers can become the fifth quarterback in NFL history with 70,000 passing yards
sources.description: In what he says will be his final NFL season, Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers is in pursuit of a statistical milestone reached by only four other quarterbacks in NFL history.
